mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5pp in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month do not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% month-over-month and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, the combination signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp
failure_condition: If the combination of HOUST increases > 10% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a positive year-over-year change in GDP (GDPC1) indicates economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If positive YoY changes in GDPC1 do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
